title: Packaging apps
text:
NotePrerequisites



You’ll need npm on your system. The first time you use the package’s npm commands, you’ll need to download all prerequisites by running npm install before trying to use of the package’s other npm commands.
You can easily package a preconfigured app to create an image browsing and citation tool for your project. There are two steps:

title: Packaging apps
Packaging apps
text:
Build
First build a current version of iiif-cite.html
cd src
npm run build
This example builds an app from a JSON file in this repository’s projects directory (../projects/complutensian.json from the perspective of the src directory). Use this syntax:
npm run package -- ../projects/complutensian.json

title: Packaging apps
text:
Result
The result is written to dist/complutensian.html. Opening it in a browser looks like this:



A packaged app


In lieu of the text inputs for manifest and URN map, there is a menu of citable manifests, open to the default collection.

title: Addressable content
text:
CautionDocumentation in progress



This page is incomplete but should provide enough examples to get you started. The live links below are to the example installation at https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, but you can replicate them just by opening a local copy of iif-cite.html in a web browser. The examples use:

this IIIF manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json
this URN map: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex

title: Addressable content
text:
Addressing raw IIIF manifest data

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
To add a IIIF manifest, append #manifest= (e.g., #manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json, live link)
To add a canvas id for a selected image, append &canvas= (e.g. &canvas=canvases/vol1_%2B_1r, live link)
To add a region of interest, append &roi= (e.g. &roi=0.3009,0.0101,0.2744,0.0586, live link). Multiple RoI values may provided, separated by semicolons. (e.g. &roi=0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940;0.1733,0.5565,0.5414,0.1967, live link)

title: Addressable content
text:
Addressing cataloged files

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
To add a delimited-text catalog, append &catalog= (e.g., #catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex, live link)
To use precomputed thumbnail images for light table view, append &thumbs=1 (live link)

title: Addressable content
section: Addressing citable image data from IIIF sources
text:
Addressing citable image data from IIIF sources

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
Add a manifest with #manifest= and a URN map with urns= (e.g., manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-v1-manifest.json&urns=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/iiif/complutensian-bne-vol1-urns.cex, live link)
Append references to images with one or more additions of &urn= (e.g.urn=urn:cite2:citebne:complutensian1.v1:v1p5@0.1857,0.1178,0.5239,0.0940, live link)

title: Addressable content
section: Addressing citable image data from cataloged images
text:
Addressing citable image data from cataloged images

Start from the address of a ready-to-use installation of iiif-cite.html (e.g. https://neelsmith.github.io/iiif-cite/iiif-cite.html, live link)
Add a delimited-text catalog with &catalog= (e.g., #catalog=https://shot.holycross.edu/images/mss/lipsius7/lips7.cex, live link)
Append references to images with one or more additions of &urn= (e.g.&urn=urn:cite2:citeleiden:lipsius7.v1:IMG_1203@0.4187,0.3937,0.1598,0.0182, live link)
